items.html: And afterwards, when they were divided in the aforementioned manner, behold, the VAK of Gadlut enter in this manner: first the three lower ones, the NHY within them, enter into the KHB of ZA, which are still included in his ChGT; and afterwards the three middle ones enter into the GAR of ZA, the KHB; and the NHY of the Mochin are pushed down into the ChGT of ZA. And behold, now the aspect of the VAK of Gadlut is completed. And when the GAR of Gadlut enter, then the three middle ones of the Mochin are pushed down into the three middle ones of ZA, and the three lower ones of the Mochin are pushed down into the three lower ones of ZA, and it is completed into ten Sefirot.
